what_happened: Blocker research places Step 2 (nxt-exposing deletion theorem) in LadderPump.lean's Del section, but LadderChain.lean imports LadderPump.lean (not the reverse) and the z-anchored lift it depends on lives in LadderChain.lean's Assembly section; LadderPump.lean is also at 1485 lines against the 1500 longFile limit. Plan relocates every new declaration to LadderChain.lean.

Task description and blocker research claim the residual anchor inequality is dischargeable from nxtAt_le_cntAt_add_of_next_region plus hgap and hTc. Authoring-time reading of the register relation (Drift permits n'=n+1 at every step; the forward window bounds n from above, the already-free direction) shows the upper direction nxtAt g s0 - n <= (s0 - z) - l has no landed source and is refuted by a climbing-register path. Plan makes Phase 3 a decision gate with the FAIL branch (named forward-slack side hypothesis) fully specified, per the task's own HONEST OUTCOME clause.

Both pinned Challenge statements were elaborated standalone against the built library at plan-authoring time (lake env lean, exit 0) before being written into the plan, so the pinned signatures are verified rather than guessed.
Phase 1 z-anchored lift landed first build; only linter noise (show/change on beta-reduced goals), fixed by deleting the no-op restatements.
Phase 2 deletion theorem with exposed register landed on the first build; sanity instance recovered the landed theorem.

Phase 3 gate: the research's claim that the single-pin bound is dischargeable from the forward window plus hgap and hTc measured FALSE. omega closes the lower direction (n - nxtAt s0 <= C + I - l) and leaves the upper direction open with counterexample n=0, C=3, I=1, l=1, nxtAt s0=4 (Drift's n'=n+1 rung at every step). Plan's expected FAIL branch taken: HasForwardSlack landed as a named def.

First git-commit-scoped.sh invocation for phase 3 reported 'absent from HEAD' for two staged paths and 'Nothing to commit or git commit failed (non-blocking)'; the files were left staged and an identical retry committed cleanly (89809bb27). Transient; no content lost.
Phase 4 downward assembly compiled on the first build on the FAIL branch; only a long-line docstring warning needed reflowing.

Phase 5: lean-challenge-snapshot.sh --check exits 71 because no Challenge manifest was ever taken for this task at plan time; the advisory check was replaced by a manual comparison of the two pinned signatures (match).
